equations.text:
nu_bar(ell) ~ C ell^(-1/3),                 ell down to 0,
    E N_bar((0,t])/V_X ~ (3/2) C t^(2/3),       t down to 0.        (1)

O_(p,q)=(F(p),grad F(p),F(q),grad F(q)),
    Delta_(p,q)=|det Hess F(p) det Hess F(q)|,
    tau_(p,q)=1{Hess F(p)<0} 1{Hess F(q) has index d-1},
    W_(p,q)=Delta_(p,q) tau_(p,q).                           (2)

E sum_(p!=q,grad F(p)=grad F(q)=0) w(p,q,F)
      =integral_(p!=q) p_(grad F(p),grad F(q))(0)
                           E[Delta_(p,q) w | both gradients=0]
                           dvol(p) dvol(q).                (3)

K_sel(p,q,b,s)=p_O(b,0,s,0) E_Q[W_(p,q) sigma(p,q,F)],
    nu_bar(ell)=V_X^(-1) integral_(p!=q) integral_R
                       K_sel(p,q,b,b-ell) db dvol(p) dvol(q).   (4)
min_(closure B_i) f > lambda for each ball in the chain.

D_f(p)=sup{lambda in Q: lambda<f(p),
         exists z in D with f(z)>f(p) connected to p in {f>lambda}}, (5)

H_i=[ r alpha_i   r beta_i^T ]
        [ r beta_i        A_i   ].                       (10)

alpha_M -> -6k, alpha_S -> 6k,
    beta_M,beta_S bounded, A_M,A_S -> A_0.
det H_i/r=alpha_i det A_i-r beta_i^T adj(A_i) beta_i.   (11)

dvol(M) dvol(S)
       =J(x,r u) dvol(x) r^(d-1) dr d sigma_x(u).          (13)

spatial polar volume         r^(d-1) dr,
    height change s=b-k r^3       r^3 db dk,
    original observation density 12 r^(-(d+3)) pi_r(v_r),
    selected determinant weight  r^2 E_Qr[V_r sigma].

ell^(1/3) nu_near(ell)
      =(1/(3 V_X)) integral_(SX,R,(0,infinity))
          1{k>=ell/r_0^3} k^(-2/3)
          J(x,(ell/k)^(1/3)u)
          B_((ell/k)^(1/3))(b,k,x,u)
          dvol(x) d sigma_x(u) db dk.

C=(4/V_X) integral_(SX,R,(0,infinity))
                    k^(-2/3) pi_0(v_0) z_0(b,k,x,u)
                    dvol(x) d sigma_x(u) db dk.             (14)

odd:  G=grad F (dimension d), T=F_uuu (one scalar);
    even: F, V=Hess F(u,.) (dimension d), A=Hess F|_(u-perp). (15)

integral_R p_(F,V)(b,0)
        E[(det A)^2 1{A<0} | F=b,V=0] db
      =p_V(0) D_(x,u).                                    (17)

144 integral_0^infinity k^(4/3) phi_tau(12k) dk
      =12^(-1/3) integral_0^infinity t^(4/3) phi_tau(t) dt
      =Gamma(7/6) tau^(4/3)/(24^(1/3) sqrt(pi)).            (18)

C=Gamma(7/6)/(24^(1/3) sqrt(pi) V_X)
       *integral_SX p_G(0) p_V(0) tau_(x,u)^(4/3)
                                             D_(x,u)
                    dvol(x) d sigma_x(u).                  (19)

xi_r=m_r+P_r Z,
    m_r=L_r^T (L_r L_r^T)^(-1) v_r,
    P_r=I-L_r^T (L_r L_r^T)^(-1) L_r,                     (20)
R=S/sqrt(E S^2), F=R H, E S^2=alpha/(alpha+2).

E N_F((0,t])
      >=E N_H([a,b]) P(R<=t/b)
      =c t^alpha, c>0.                                   (24)

s=gamma+m-a+w,
    r^s B_r dr db dk d(other parameters).
(1/m) integral k^(-(s+1)/m) B_0 db dk d(other parameters). (25)

K_L(z)=sum_(j in Z^d) exp(-|z+Lj|^2/2)/S_(d,L),
    S_(d,L)=sum_(j in Z^d) exp(-|Lj|^2/2).                 (2)

q_n=exp(-omega^2 |n|^2/2)/Z_(d,L),
    Z_(d,L)=sum_(j in Z^d) exp(-omega^2 |j|^2/2), n in Z^d. (3)

a_n=(1/(L^d S_(d,L))) integral_Rd
                   exp(-|z|^2/2) exp(-i omega n.z) dz
        =(2pi)^(d/2)/(L^d S_(d,L)) exp(-omega^2 |n|^2/2).

F(z)=sqrt(q_0) C_0+sum_pairs sqrt(2q_n)
                   [C_n cos(omega n.z)+S_n sin(omega n.z)]. (5)
E ||F||Cq^p<infinity for each integer q>=0 and finite p>0. (6)

U_r F -> U_0 F in every finite Lp and almost surely,
    sup_(x,R,0<r<=1) |U_r F|<=C ||F||C3,

12 pi_r(v_r) E_Qr[W_r/r^2]
      <=C(1+|b|+k)^(2d) exp[-c(b^2+k^2)],
    integral_Rx(0,infinity) k^(-2/3) RHS db dk<infinity.    (10)

E sum_(p!=q,grad F(p)=grad F(q)=0) w(p,q,F)
      =integral_(p!=q) p_(grad F(p),grad F(q))(0)
          E[|det H_p det H_q| w | both gradients=0] dp dq. (11)

integral_R p_O(b,0,b-ell,0)
              E_Q[|det H_p det H_q|] db <=C,
    0<=nu_bar,far(ell)<=nu_cand,far(ell)<=C.                (14)
r^(d-1) dr, r^3 db dk, 12r^(-(d+3)) pi_r, r^2 E[V_r sigma_r],

c_(d,L)=4 integral_(R,(0,infinity),S^(d-1))
                    k^(-2/3) pi_0(v_0) z_0 db dk d sigma. (16)
Cov(L_a F,L_b F)=sum_n q_n P_a(omega n) conjugate(P_b(omega n)),

Cov(G_i,G_j)=omega^2 sum q_n n_i n_j,
    Cov(H_ij,H_kl)=omega^4 sum q_n n_i n_j n_k n_l,
    Cov(F_uuu,G_j)=-omega^4 sum q_n (n.u)^3 n_j,
    Var(F_uuu)=omega^6 sum q_n (n.u)^6.                    (17)

c_(d,L)=Gamma(7/6)/(24^(1/3) sqrt(pi))
       *integral_(S^(d-1)) p_G(0) p_Vu(0) tau_u^(4/3)
                                             D_u d sigma(u). (19)

K_L(z)=sum_(j in Z^d) exp(-|z+Lj|^2/2)
             /sum_(j in Z^d) exp(-|Lj|^2/2).                 (1)
E[N_(Tt) 1{N_(Tt)>=2}] = o(t^(2/3)) for every fixed T. (4)

M=x-r u/2, S=x+r u/2,
    F(M)=b, F(S)=b-k r^3, grad F(M)=grad F(S)=0.           (6)
Xi_t=sum_(finite bars) delta_(ell/t, b, k, M, u)       (7)

v_r=(b-k r^3/2,-k r^2,0,12k,0,...,0),
    pi_r(v_r)=the U_r density at this target,
    Q_r=the conditional full-field law given U_r=v_r.

W_r=|det H_M det H_S|
          1{H_M negative definite, index(H_S)=d-1},
    V_r=W_r/r^2,
    z_0(b,k,u)=36 k^2 E_Q0[(det A_0)^2 1{A_0<0}].          (8)

F_r -> F_0 globally in C4,
    V_r -> V_0=36k^2(det A_0)^2 1{A_0<0},
    E_Qr[V_r sigma_r] -> z_0(b,k,u),                      (9)

12 pi_r(v_r) E_Qr V_r <= H(b,k),
    H(b,k)=C(1+|b|+k)^(2d) exp[-c(b^2+k^2)],
    integral_Rx(0,infinity) k^(-2/3) H(b,k) db dk<infinity. (10)

t^(-2/3) E[Xi_t h]_near
      =integral_(a,b,k,x,u) a^(-1/3)
         1{k>=ta/r_0^3}
         [12 pi_r(v_r)/(3 k^(2/3))]
         E_Qr[V_r sigma_r]
         h(a,b,k,x-r u/2,u) da db dk dx d sigma(u),
    r=(ta/k)^(1/3), 0<a<=T.                              (11)

t^(-2/3) E[Xi_t h] -> integral_E h d eta,              (13)
    d eta=4 a^(-1/3) k^(-2/3) pi_0(v_0) z_0(b,k,u)
                      da db dk dx d sigma(u).             (14)

beta(b,u)=4 integral_0^infinity
                    k^(-2/3) pi_0(v_0) z_0(b,k,u) dk,
    d eta_(a,b,x,u)=a^(-1/3) beta(b,u)
                              da db dx d sigma(u).        (15)

c_(d,L)=Gamma(7/6)/(24^(1/3) sqrt(pi))
       * integral_S p_G(0) p_Vu(0) tau_u^(4/3)
          E[(det A_u)^2 1{A_u<0}|V_u=0] d sigma(u),       (17)

V_(r_t) sigma_(r_t)
          1{N_(Tt)(F_(r_t))>=2} ->0 almost surely,
    E_Q_(r_t)[V_(r_t) sigma_(r_t)
          1{N_(Tt)>=2}] ->0.                             (19)
